Amazon is now delivering all MacBook Neo models by Friday (if not sooner) and we are still tracking the best deal ever on official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by this 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro hitting its best price ever at a giant $400 off. We also have M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB at $150 off and the return of one of the best Apple Watch Series 11 deals – the 46mm cell at $130 off. We also have the new 2026 Apple Studio Displays at up to $200 off and all-time low pricing on Anker’s Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Charging Station at 30% off. Everything awaits below.

  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by Friday

Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting down at best price ever right now (Nearly 40% off)

There are plans of more affordable MagSafe batteries out there for iPhone Air users, but perhaps none more elegant than the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery – and it is currently sitting down at the Amazon all-time low at nearly 40% off.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery that launched alongside the new ultra-thin handset back in September down at the best price we have tracked to date.

This 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro just hit its best price ever at a giant $400 off

We are still tracking a number of up to $300 price drops on the new 14-inch 2026 MacBook Pro models, but we are touching down this morning to highlight this 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $400 off the list price – the best we have tracked to date.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s new 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM at $2,899, or $300 off the regular $3,099 list price. That’s a solid deal and the lowest we have tracked at Amazon, but B&H has it beat this morning:

Authorized Apple dealer B&H is now offering this same 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM and the 1TB internal SSD down at $2,799 shipped. This is the Space Black model – the Silver is sitting at the same price as Amazon.

Regularly $3,099, as mentioned above, this is a nicely upgraded M5 Pro machine with the larger 16-inches of Liquid Retina XDR Display real estate now sitting at $400 off the list price.

Today’s deal delivers the lowest price we have tracked to date on this configuration and one of the best deals on any 2026 MacBook.

Clearly a 48GB 16-inch model isn’t going to be the machine most folks are after, but if you are considering one of these upgraded, future-proof configs, it doesn’t get any better than $400 off right now.

For some of the more accessible options, scope out the updated deal options on the models below instead – you are looking at between $250 and $300 off the more affordable models here:

M5 MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,539 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,735 (Reg. $1,899) – New all-time low
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $2,099) – New all-time low

M5 Pro MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,984 (Reg. $2,199) – Amazon all-time low/or $1,949 at B&H
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,617 (Reg. $2,799) – Amazon all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,528 (Reg. $2,699)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,899 (Reg. $3,099) – $100 less at B&H

M5 MacBook Air prices are jumping back up, land the 16GB/1TB model at $150 off while you still can

We have had a steady run of discounts on the new M5 MacBook Air lineup, and there are still some solid offers live across the 15-inch models, but the more affordable 13-inchers are disappearing quick. If you’re looking to jump in, Amazon is still offering all four colors on the least pricey 1TB model at $150 off.

Amazon is currently offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB internal storage capacity down at $1,149 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,299 machine at $150 off the list price to match the best deal we have tracked to date.

Unlike a few of the 15-inch models, Amazon remains the best place to score this 13-inch configuration while the $150 price drops remain. It has started to bring the price back up on select 13-inch models, including the entry config and the 24GB variant, but this mid-range 16GB/1TB is holding strong…for now.

While I have always favored spending the money on the RAM over the storage, it is really only a matter of time before Apple’s 512GB configs go the way of the old, no longer available 256GB, leaving the 1TB model as, what’s starting to feel like, a more future-proof investment at this point. And this is the least pricey 1TB M5 model you can buy at the lowest price we have tracked.

Here are those aforementioned 15-inch models if you’re looking for the larger display – these three configs are undercutting Amazon by up to $30 right now:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,129 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,329 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,519 (Reg. $1,699)

One of the best Apple Watch Series 11 deals is back: 46mm at $130 off

Arguably one of the best Apple Watch Series 11 deals we have tracked yet has now returned. While we are seeing deeper deals on the pricey Titanium variants, Amazon is once again offering the $130 price drop on the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell models.

Amazon has all four case colors of the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model sitting back down at $399 shipped. The smaller and less pricey 42mm model is actually sitting at the same price right now (that one is $100 off its list price).

This is a $529 configuration seeing a solid $130 price drop to bring it back down to the lowest price we have ever tracked. We saw this same Series 11 configuration drop to $459 for Black Friday last year, and then down to the previous low at $429 ahead of the holidays and a couple times this year. But at $130 off, you’re looking at the lowest price we have tracked to date at Amazon.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $529)

As seen above, you will still find a limited selection of 42mm GPS-only models starting from $299 and the $100 price drops on the same 46mm model are all still live starting from $329 if you don’t want the Cell connectivity option. But the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell is clearly the standout deal here, and it is now back for the taking.

And for those who are looking towards the higher-end Titanium case models, there are still some notable Amazon all-time lows live at up to $160 off:

Apple’s mid-range 512GB M4 iPad Air just hit a new Amazon all-time low at $100 off

We caught some short-lived but quite notable deals on the 128GB and 256GB 13-inch M4 iPad Air last week, but today Amazon is serving up its best price to date on another mid-range model at $100 off – the 512GB 13-inch.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB 13-inch M4 iPad Air down at $999 shipped. This is a regularly $1,099 machine seeing a solid $100 price drop for the lowest we can find.

We did catch the 256GB 13-inch at $110 off last week before quickly jumping back up in price, but today’s deal is the best we have ever tracked on Amazon for the 512GB model.

I still happen to think these clearance deals on the now previous-gen M3 iPad Air might be a better option for some folks:
